sentences.en: This site has a lack of transcriptions.
Complex transcriptions are difficult to read.
sentences.zh: 复杂的书面标注对于阅读来说很难。

sentences.en: The teacher asked the students to listen and write down the transcription.
sentences.zh: 老师让同学们听录音并写下转录内容。

senses.zh: 抄写；标音 - 抄本，副本，文字记录 - 翻译；按速记稿在打字机上打出文字 - 编曲 - 录音；录制
